about: The main headings of Pahl & Beitz's checklist for drawing up a requirements list (Pahl, Beitz, Feldhusen & Grote 2007, Engineering Design, 3rd ed., section 5.2). Every heading has a metric or the owner's statement that nothing applies.

headings.name: Geometry
headings.covers: size, height, breadth, length, diameter, space requirement, number, arrangement, connection, extension

headings.name: Kinematics
headings.covers: type of motion, direction of motion, velocity, acceleration

headings.name: Forces
headings.covers: direction of force, magnitude of force, frequency of force, weight, load, deformation, stiffness, elasticity, stability, resonance

headings.name: Energy
headings.covers: output, efficiency, loss, friction, ventilation, state variables such as pressure and temperature, heating, cooling, supply, storage, capacity, conversion

headings.name: Material
headings.covers: physical and chemical properties of the initial and final product, auxiliary materials, prescribed materials

headings.name: Signals
headings.covers: inputs and outputs, form, display, control equipment

headings.name: Safety
headings.covers: direct safety principles, protective systems, operational, operator and environmental safety

headings.name: Ergonomics
headings.covers: user interface, type of operation, clarity of layout, lighting, aesthetics

headings.name: Production
headings.covers: factory limitations, maximum possible dimensions, preferred production methods, means of production, achievable quality and tolerances, wastage

headings.name: Quality control
headings.covers: possibilities of testing and measuring, application of special regulations and standards

headings.name: Transport
headings.covers: limitations due to lifting gear, clearance, means of transport (height and weight), nature and conditions of despatch

headings.name: Operation
headings.covers: quietness, wear, special uses, marketing area, destination

headings.name: Maintenance
headings.covers: servicing intervals, inspection, exchange and repair, painting, cleaning

headings.name: Costs
headings.covers: maximum permissible manufacturing costs, cost of tooling, investment and depreciation

headings.name: Schedules
headings.covers: end date of development, project planning and control, delivery date
